privacy: Your database stays in this browser. No uploads or automatic storage.
formats: Open or drop a .db, .sqlite, or .sqlite3 file, up to 50 MiB.
emptyDatabase: This database has no user tables or views. You can still run a SELECT query.
sqlHint: Run one SELECT, WITH, or EXPLAIN statement. Ctrl/⌘ + Enter to run.
truncated: Row or size limit reached. Exports include all loaded rows across pages. Narrow your query to retrieve a smaller result.
notRun: Select a table or run a SQL query to see results.
exportNote: Exports include all loaded rows across pages. JSON uses separate columns and rows arrays to preserve duplicate column names; integers are decimal strings and BLOBs contain a $blob hex value. CSV uses blank fields for NULL and prefixes formula-like text with an apostrophe.
chooseTable: Select a table or view to inspect its structure.
limitsNote: The original database is never modified. Encrypted databases and WAL/journal sidecar files are not supported; use a checkpointed database copy. Queries run for up to 10 seconds.
invalid: Choose a valid, unencrypted SQLite 3 database. If it uses WAL, checkpoint it before opening a copy.
tooLarge: This database exceeds the 50 MiB limit. Open a smaller database.
readOnlyError: Only read-only SELECT, WITH, and EXPLAIN statements are supported. Use Structure to inspect schema information.
singleStatement: Run one SQL statement at a time.
queryTooLarge: This SQL query is too long. Keep it under 100,000 characters.
schemaLimit: This database has more than 2,000 tables and views. Open a smaller database.
timeout: This operation exceeded 10 seconds and was stopped. Try a smaller or more selective query.
workerError: Could not read the database. Try opening it again.
sampleError: Unable to load the sample. Try again or open a database.
exportError: Unable to prepare this download. Try exporting fewer rows.
